dataspace.description: Developer name of the dataspace the retrieve was scoped to.

targetComponent.description: The user-requested component, in TYPE:NAME form, e.g. "CalculatedInsight:highValueCustomer".

retrievedComponents.description: The requested component plus its server-resolved dependency graph.

fileWriteLocation.description: Write root for this retrieve (§5.2), e.g. "./data-cloud/default/". DataLakeObject definitions are written outside this dir (./data-cloud/data-lake-objects/); see "./data-cloud/manifest.json" for the authoritative inventory of all files written.

RetrieveResult.description: Shape returned by `sf data-cloud retrieve` (and what `--json` emits).

componentType.description: API value of the component type, e.g. "CalculatedInsight".

componentName.description: API/developer name of the component, e.g. "highValueCustomer".

dataspaceName.description: Developer name of the dataspace this component belongs to.

dependsOn.description: Direct dependencies (server-resolved); empty array for leaf components.

RetrievedComponentInfo.description: One component in the resolved dependency graph (standardized: no raw payload).

componentName.description: API/developer name of the depended-on component, e.g. "Divvy_TripsDmo".

componentType.description: API value of the depended-on component's type, e.g. "DataModelObject".

ComponentDependency.description: A single dependency edge (type + API name) within a component's dependency graph.
